Over the years, especially since inception of the Kwara State University, the Malete community of Kwara state has experienced significant changes and increase in economic, social and academic lifestyle. However, the ever increasing lifestyle in the Malete community has not been matched with adequate infrastructural needs, especially in relation to housing needs.

At EVC, our aim is to close this gap, bridging the housing deficit as well as introducing a new way of living to Malete and its environs. An initiative that seeks to serve a win-win situation for investors, students as well as community hosts. Way forward? Look into BROADWAY RESIDENTIALS
There are 3 categories of buildings in Broadway Residentials to cater for different level of needs of our clients.
Comprising of a living room, a bedroom, a 3 piece bathroom and kitchen. There would be only 30 units of this available in the estate and 2 units of this apartment serve as a building.
This is a stand alone building comprising of a living room, 2 bedrooms, a 3 piece bathroom and kitchen. There would be only 15 units of this available in the estate.
This is a stand alone building comprising of a living room, 3 bedrooms, a 3 piece bathroom and kitchen. There would be only 15 units of this available in the estate.
